question: 单项选择：I _____ already _____ my homework. A. has, finished  B. have, finished  C. am, finishing  D. will, finish
answer: 答案：B. have, finished。解析：现在完成时：have + 过去分词。already用于现在完成时。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She ______ (go) to Shanghai. She will be back next week.
answer: 答案：has gone。解析：现在完成时表示"去了还没回来"。

question: 单项选择：They _____ this book many times. A. read  B. reads  C. have read  D. has read
answer: 答案：C. have read。解析：主语they用have。

question: 单项选择：He _____ in this school for three years. A. works  B. worked  C. has worked  D. will work
answer: 答案：C. has worked。解析：for three years是现在完成时的标志时间状语。

question: 翻译句子：我已经看过这部电影了。
answer: 答案：I have already seen this movie. 解析：现在完成时：have + 过去分词。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：We ______ (live) in Beijing since 2010.
answer: 答案：have lived。解析：since 2010"自从2010年"，是现在完成时标志。

question: 单项选择：My father _____ just _____ back from work. A. has, come  B. have, came  C. is, come  D. was, come
answer: 答案：A. has, come。解析：just"刚刚"，与现在完成时连用。My father是第三人称单数，用has。

question: 单项选择：She _____ the book yet? A. has finished  B. have finished  C. finished  D. finishes
answer: 答案：A. has finished。解析：yet用于现在完成时，主语she用has。

question: 翻译句子：他已经去过北京两次了。
answer: 答案：He has been to Beijing twice. 解析：have been to"去过"。twice"两次"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：I ______ (know) him for five years.
answer: 答案：have known。解析：for five years是现在完成时标志。
